#!/usr/bin/python
import os, socket
base = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
path = os.path.join(base, 'run/status.sock')

#!/bin/sh
# chkconfig: 2345 90 10
# description: Legacy local status service
# processname: server.py

. /etc/init.d/functions

prog=/srv/legacy2/unix-socket-access-boundary/server.py
base=/srv/legacy2/unix-socket-access-boundary
pidfile=$base/run/statusd.pid
socketfile=$base/run/status.sock

start() {
    if [ -f "$pidfile" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$pidfile")" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "statusd is already running"
        return 0
    fi
    rm -f "$pidfile" "$socketfile"
    echo -n "Starting statusd: "
    daemon --user statusd $prog --daemon $pidfile
    retval=$?
    echo
    [ $retval -eq 0 ] || return $retval
    count=0
    while [ $count -lt 10 ]; do
        [ -S "$socketfile" ] && return 0
        count=$((count + 1))
        sleep 1
    done
    echo "statusd did not create its socket"
    return 1
}

stop() {
    echo -n "Stopping statusd: "
    if [ -f "$pidfile" ]; then
        pid=$(cat "$pidfile")
        kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null
        count=0
        while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null && [ $count -lt 10 ]; do
            count=$((count + 1))
            sleep 1
        done
    fi
    rm -f "$pidfile" "$socketfile"
    success
    echo
}

status_service() {
    if [ -f "$pidfile" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$pidfile")" 2>/dev/null && [ -S "$socketfile" ]; then
        echo "statusd is running (pid $(cat "$pidfile"))"
        return 0
    fi
    echo "statusd is stopped"
    return 3
}

case "$1" in
    start) start ;;
    stop) stop ;;
    restart|reload) stop; start ;;
    status) status_service ;;
    *) echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}"; exit 2 ;;
